requirement: Designate one point of contact with enough authority and knowledge of the critical functions to speak for the entity
evidence: Name and mandate of the contact point shared with the TLPT cyber team

requirement: Appoint the control team - the only people inside the entity who know a test is running
evidence: Control team charter, contact list, agreed secure channel

requirement: Identify the critical or important functions in scope, including outsourced ones (DORA Article 26(2))
evidence: CIF list with owning business lines, supporting ICT systems and ICT providers

requirement: Have the scope validated so the scope specification document fixes the precise scope
evidence: Approved scope specification document and test manager confirmation

requirement: Complete the initial risk assessment and safeguards (DORA Article 26(5))
evidence: Risk assessment, stop conditions, rollback and backup plan, production impact analysis

requirement: Confirm participation of ICT third-party providers in scope (DORA Article 26(3))
evidence: Written confirmations, joint test agreement, pooled testing arrangement where used

requirement: Procure a threat intelligence provider (always external) and a red team tester (DORA Article 27)
evidence: Due diligence file mapped to Article 27(1)(a)-(e), professional indemnity insurance certificate, independence declaration, NDA

requirement: Agree information classification and secure communication channels
evidence: TLP handling rules and the agreed encrypted channels

requirement: Produce entity-specific threat intelligence and attack scenarios
evidence: Targeted threat intelligence report covering target and threat intelligence

requirement: Select the scenarios at the scenario selection meeting
evidence: Approved scenario list and meeting minutes

requirement: Produce and approve the red team test plan
evidence: Finalised red team test plan signed off by the control team and the test manager
owner: Red team tester and control team

requirement: Run active testing for at least the framework minimum duration
evidence: Test logs, milestone and flag register, weekly update minutes

requirement: Keep the blue team unaware and record what it noticed
evidence: Blue team report produced after the test without prior warning

requirement: Log every red team action for the replay and for evidence
evidence: Central test log retained under the agreed classification

requirement: Agree the test summary report and the remediation plan (DORA Article 26(6))
evidence: Finalised test summary report, remediation plan with owners and dates

requirement: Submit the findings summary and remediation plans to the TLPT authority (DORA Article 26(6))
evidence: Submission record to Finantsinspektsioon or to the ECB for a directly supervised significant institution

requirement: Obtain the attestation and notify the competent authority (DORA Article 26(7))
evidence: Attestation on file and the notification of the attestation sent

requirement: Run the 360-degree feedback step with all participants
evidence: Feedback output shared with the control team

requirement: Track remediation to closure and retest where a finding warrants it
evidence: Remediation tracker with closure evidence and retest report

requirement: Schedule the next test at least every three years unless the authority sets another frequency (DORA Article 26(1))
evidence: Testing schedule approved by the board

requirement: Keep tester independence: external testers every third test where internal testers are used (DORA Article 26(8))
evidence: Tester register with appointment history

requirement: Report the outcome to the board and make it available to internal audit (DORA Article 6(5))
evidence: Board minutes and internal audit working papers
